# Signal-to-System

One skill, ten independent workflows that turn knowledge, evidence, and repeated work into useful outcomes: rank a messy idea pile, scan current public signals, turn research into a decision record, redesign a recurring workflow, match a job to the right person/tool/service with a handoff brief, design a cheap falsifiable experiment with an append-only ledger, build workshop materials, run a creative project control pack, compound session notes into decisions, or map proven work to a product form. No fixed pipeline — you pick the workflow that owns the job; every artifact carries visible evidence labels and a concrete next action. No account, no API key needed.
